topic.source_contract: Reservoir extreme-flood maps, flood-planning and emergency-plan evidence

facts.separation: not the same as Flood Zone 2 or 3
facts.guard: outline is not a probability or defence-failure forecast

facts.requirement: large raised reservoirs need on-site emergency flood plans
facts.guard: operator duty is not proof of candidate protection or evacuation feasibility
flood-zone data and reservoir outlines remain distinct

facts.evidence: reservoir information may be relevant through long-term flood-risk sources
facts.guard: map trigger does not replace a site-specific FRA
standing advice is procedural evidence and not a candidate outcome

scope_guards: Reservoir flood mapping represents an extreme scenario and is not Flood Zone 2 or 3.
A reservoir outline is not a probability, timing or forecast of dam failure.
Reservoir owner and operator emergency duties do not prove site-specific evacuation or protection.
The relevant reservoir owner, local SFRA and emergency-planning evidence must be checked together.
Flood Map for Planning and long-term flood-risk products have different purposes.
A map trigger does not replace a satisfactory site-specific flood-risk assessment.
Flood defences, reservoir safety regulation and planning acceptability remain distinct.
No score or promotion is written without exact site, reservoir source, depth/velocity, FRA, emergency and planning evidence.
